surface.host: apps/web/src/permissions.tsx renders the view only for an active TENANT_ADMIN binding with TENANT scope
surface.transport: same-origin fetch with cache no-store, x-csrf-token and one UUID idempotency-key per confirmation

behavior.strictListParsing: Each registry row must carry a well-formed template key/version, a 64-hex template hash, a bounded certification reference, a UTC timestamp and a consistent active/activeVersion pair. The list must declare platformCertification LOCAL_GOLDEN_ONLY, liveVerified false, a boolean truncated flag and at most 200 unique rows; anything else clears the view without showing data.
behavior.rollbackEligibility: Only a registered, non-active version that has a current active record can be opened for rollback, and the confirmation carries the exact active revision read from the registry as expectedRevision.
behavior.publishGuards: Publish accepts only registry-shaped key/version plus a review reference of at least 8 characters, and refuses a version already registered in the tenant so publishing can never silently overwrite.
behavior.singleSubmission: Each confirmation generates one UUID idempotency key and sends exactly one request; a second click or a repeat confirmation is ignored and no request is resent automatically.
behavior.receiptBinding: A receipt must match the intent item by item (template, version, operation, requestId, activeVersion, activeRevision, platformCertification, liveVerified). A rollback receipt must carry activeRevision equal to expectedRevision+1. A replayed receipt must carry currentActiveVersion and currentActiveRevision that are not older than the receipt revision; otherwise the result is treated as unverifiable and the confirmation is erased.
behavior.failureHandling: 4xx, 5xx and network failures produce administrator-facing Chinese notices only, never server text, never a success state and never a retained old registry; 401 clears all data and invokes the existing session-lost callback.
behavior.lifecycle: Visibility change or unmount clears the registry, the pending confirmation and any late reply; a non-admin session neither renders the view nor issues any registry request.
behavior.noUpstreamAccess: The view never reads or writes business data, carries no SQL, row scope, credential or upstream tool name, and never claims platform certification.
